# Local data directory

Everything in this directory is **local, generated, and gitignored** (only
this README is committed). The dictionary data and its derived artifacts are
excluded from the public repository because the **license status of the
dictionary data is unresolved** (see `SOURCES.md`).

## Files (generated by the scripts)

| File | Produced by | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `basic.json` | `scripts/fetch_dictionary.py` | Raw dictionary artifact from the live site (19,101 rows) |
| `manifest.json` | `scripts/fetch_dictionary.py` | Provenance: url, retrieved_at, sha256, size, row_count, schema, license_status |
| `lexicon.tsv` | `scripts/generate_lexicon.py` | Full-form lexicon: headwords + generated paradigms (`form\tlemma\txpos\tupos\tfeats\tentry_type`) |
| `lexicon.manifest.json` | `scripts/generate_lexicon.py` | Provenance: dictionary hash, entry_count, morphology version, sha256 |

## How to (re)generate

```bash
python3 scripts/fetch_dictionary.py      # needs network; writes basic.json + manifest.json
python3 scripts/generate_lexicon.py      # needs Node deps installed (npm ci in src/morphology_backend/)
```

## Reproducibility

Each generated artifact has a companion manifest recording its source hash,
size, and generation time. Every `isv-eval` run embeds the dictionary manifest
and morphology package version into `report.json`, so a result can always be
traced back to the exact resources it was measured against.

## License

Do **not** commit these files and do **not** redistribute them until the
dictionary data license is clarified. `manifest.json` records
`license_status: UNRESOLVED`.
